title: Vegetable Egg Muffin Cups
description: Baked egg cups loaded with spinach, cheese and bell peppers — portable and easy to reheat.
steps: Whisk the eggs with milk and seasoning.
Divide the spinach, cheese and pepper among 6 muffin cups, then pour over the egg mixture.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until set.
notes: Bake a batch and keep refrigerated for 5 days — reheats in 20 seconds for a near-instant protein snack.
